title: News2Signal Dataset Row
description: Schema for a single labeled row in the News2Signal benchmark dataset.

headline.description: Synthetic or paraphrased news headline. Must not be copied from real news articles.

summary.description: Brief synthetic summary of the news item (2-4 sentences). Must not reproduce real copyrighted content.

asset.description: Primary asset ticker or identifier most directly affected by this news.

sector.description: Sector or thematic area most relevant to this news item.

event_type.description: The primary type of market-moving event described in the news.

expected_direction.description: Expected directional market impact on the primary asset.

time_horizon.description: Expected time horizon over which the directional signal is most applicable.

confidence_label.description: Human labeler confidence in the direction and horizon assignment.

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this direction and horizon were assigned. Should reference the specific news content and causal mechanism.

not_financial_advice.description: Must always be true. This dataset is for research and evaluation only, not trading advice.
